T1.1.title: Palettes
T1.1.summary: Five palettes from the C source plus the fade_page colour-31 region overrides, each entry as {index, rgb4, rgba8}. The review app draws the swatches from the JSON. Check counts, glance at swatches, and compare a few values to the cited source.

items.title: textcolors — text/status palette
items.look_for: 20 swatches. Spot values: [0] 0x0000 black; [1] 0x0fff white; [2] 0x0c00 → (204,0,0) red; [19] 0x0c70 → (204,119,0) orange-brown (the last entry).

items.title: introcolors — intro palette
items.look_for: 32 swatches. Spot values: [0] 0x0000 black; [1] 0x0fff white; [31] 0x0eee → (238,238,238) light grey.

items.title: sun_colors — sun colour ramp
items.look_for: 53 swatches forming a ramp: starts at 0x000 black, rises through dark blues and purples, then turns pink and orange (0xF9x-0xF8x) toward the end. The final entry [52] 0x076f → (119,102,255) is a blue-violet, breaking the ramp; [26] is 0x076e → (119,102,238).

items.title: blackcolors — all-black palette
items.look_for: 32 swatches, all black: every entry is 0x0000 → (0,0,0).

items.title: region_overrides — fade_page colour-31 variants
items.look_for: Colour 31 only. Region 4 = 0x0980 → (153,136,0) olive; region 9 = 0x0445 → (68,68,85) dark grey-blue; region 9 while secret_timer is non-zero = 0x00f0 → (0,255,0) bright green; all other regions = 0x0bdf (same as pagecolors[31]).
